description: We sell professional tech equipment and accessories with fast shipping and excellent customer service.

faq.question: What is your shipping policy?
faq.answer: We offer free shipping on orders over $50. Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days.

faq.question: Do you accept returns?
faq.answer: Yes, we accept returns within 30 days of purchase. Items must be unused and in original packaging.

faq.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.answer: We accept all major credit cards, PayPal, and Apple Pay.

policies.title: Warranty
policies.content: All products come with a manufacturer's warranty. Extended warranty available for purchase.

policies.title: Price Match
policies.content: We match competitor prices on identical products. Just show us the ad.
